key_components_guidelines.ats_optimizer_dashboard: Side-by-side or tabbed panel: Left side for uploaded Resume text/score preview & JD text; Right side for weighted score gauge (0-100), sub-scores (Format 20%, Keywords 40%, Experience 20%, Skills 20%), 12-section suggestion report accordion with copy buttons, revision diff view (original vs revised), and email/cover letter generator modals.
key_components_guidelines.ctc_calculator_grid: Dual-mode input (CTC to Structure OR Desired Take-home to CTC). Breakdown table with columns: Component, Annual Amount (₹), Monthly Amount (₹), In-CTC (Yes/No), Tax Status (Exempt/Taxable/Partial). 12-month projection grid (April-March) with interactive monthly override inputs, HRA/LTA claim toggles, and instant PDF/Excel payslip view.
key_components_guidelines.tax_planner_comparison: Side-by-side Old Regime vs New Regime comparison matrix for FY 2025-26, 2026-27, 2027-28, 2028-29 with version status badges ('Enacted' / 'Provisional'). Highlight recommended regime with clear savings callout badge. Section 80C, 80D, NPS (80CCD 1B), HRA, 80TTA deduction inputs with immediate tax delta update and downloadable Excel workbook generator.
key_components_guidelines.admin_panel: Dense data dashboard for Tax Rules (JSON & Tier Editor), ATS Rubric Weights, User Management, and System Audit Logs with search, filters, and JSON validator.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, export actions, tab switches, file dropzone) MUST have kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='ats-resume-upload-input', data-testid='ctc-calculate-button', data-testid='tax-regime-switch').
testing_and_accessibility.inr_formatting: Format all currency amounts in Indian Numbering System (e.g., ₹12,50,000 instead of ₹1,250,000) with proper rupee symbol ₹.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the Navbar includes all required links: Home, Resume Enhancement, CTC Calculator, Tax Planner, My Documents, My Calculations, Pricing (disabled badge), Login/Sign Up, and User Profile menu.
Use Lucide-React icons or Phosphor icons for clean, modern visual cues across all cards and metrics.
Do NOT use pure black background. Keep background light (#F8FAFC) as requested by user choices.

Ensure all numbers, CTC breakdowns, ATS scores, and tax savings are interactive and calculate dynamically based on real Indian tax slabs (Standard Deduction ₹75,000 for New Regime FY 25-26, Surcharge slabs, Cess 4%, etc.).
Provide clear disclaimers on home landing page regarding financial advice.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
